name: RHBBANK
recent: RHB Bank 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，净利同比下滑，主要受信贷费用增加和债券收益率上升影响。同期，公司电子支付交易量增长 37% 至 12 亿笔，并与 Public Gold ATM 合作拓展黄金购买渠道。此外，EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间频繁申报股权变动。
notable: 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，净利同比下滑。
电子支付交易量增长 37% 至 12 亿笔。
与 Public Gold ATM 及 BonusLink 合作，允许使用积分购买黄金。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动，需关注其持股变化。
第三季度净利下滑，主要因信贷费用增加和债券收益率上升。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 2,155.73 百万，净利为 MYR 807.15 百万，净利率 37.4%。营收环比下降 1.6%，净利环比下降 5.8%；同比营收微降 0.1%，净利微增 0.5%。

recent_en: RHB Bank reported lower 3Q 2026 net profit, weighed by higher credit charges and rising bond yields. Meanwhile, its e-payments volume grew 37% to 1.2 billion transactions, and it partnered with Public Gold ATM to enable gold purchases. EPF also made frequent substantial shareholder filings between October and November.
notable_en: Reported 3Q 2026 results with lower year-on-year net profit.
E-payments volume rose 37% to 1.2 billion transactions.
Partnered with Public Gold ATM and BonusLink to enable gold purchases using loyalty points.
risks_en: EPF made multiple substantial shareholder filings between October and November; its shareholding changes warrant attention.
3Q net profit declined due to higher credit charges and rising bond yields.
earnings_en: For 2Q 2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 2,155.73 million and net income was MYR 807.15 million, with a net margin of 37.4%. Revenue fell 1.6% QoQ and net income fell 5.8% QoQ; revenue was down 0.1% YoY while net income rose 0.5% YoY.
